concerns.text: Spec defines the primary baseline as 'Non-COVID' = ALL other vaccines ('The "non-COVID" comparison group will include all other vaccine types'), with Flu-only used only for FR-007 sensitivity. T004/T006 silently narrow the primary baseline to 'Non-COVID-Non-Flu', changing every ROR/PRR/IC value in the study. This is a semantic weakening of FR-001/FR-002 with no spec authorization; either amend the spec or restore the all-non-COVID baseline.

US-3 acceptance scenario 2 requires 'the final output list contains only SOCs with an adjusted p-value < 0.05'. T006 writes signals.csv for ALL examined SOCs and defines is_signal purely by the 2-of-3 threshold (FR-005) with no BH-significance condition. The acceptance criterion is dropped; T006/T010 must either filter or add the adj-p<0.05 condition to signal flagging.

FR-003 requires BH correction 'for the cross-sectional ROR/PRR/IC metrics, outputting adjusted p-values for every metric'. T006 computes one Fisher raw p-value and one p_value_adj; no per-metric adjusted p-values exist in signals.csv or the signal schema. Either the spec must be narrowed explicitly or T006 must produce per-metric adjusted p-values.

T002 hard-codes guessed vaers.hhs.gov zip URLs and an NLM MedDRA-SNOMED 'primary candidate' mapping, while the plan's Constitution Check claims 'Only verified URLs from the Verified datasets block are used' and Phase 1 specifies a verified parquet. The tasks document itself admits the prior URLs 'were unresolved 404 claims'. Introducing unverified source URLs as the canonical recipe violates Constitution II; the task should require a verified source block before implementation rather than shipping guessed URLs with a runtime-fail escape hatch.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 vs plan.md:Phase 4 / data-model.md:Temporal Profile Record
concerns.text: T008 computes week_offset relative to the median REPT_DATE of the COMBINED COVID + Non-COVID cohort, while plan Phase 4 and the data model specify the median of the COVID-19 cohort. Pick one reference date and align tasks/plan/data-model so SC-003 evidence is unambiguous.

T004 requires mapping coverage ≥ 95% of observed PTs; the data model constraint says the mapping 'must contain at least 95% of observed SOC_CODEs'. These are different denominators (PT-level vs SOC-level); align the stated coverage metric so the logs/clean_summary.txt check has one defined pass condition.

T009 measures peak RSS with psutil; plan Phase 6 mandates memory_profiler. Not a weakening of SC-004 itself, but the plan's described method and the task's deliverable disagree — align one so the SC-004 artifact matches the documented method.
